$comment: Regression fixture for the co-brand lockup (1.6.1), graded by `run_evals.py cobrand`.
The grader copies this folder to a temp deck (deck-state.json declares the cobrand;
assets/client-logo.png is a synthetic, brand-neutral wordmark), creates one slide per
role below with new_slide.py, and requires (1) every copy to report 'lockup applied',
(2) a clean qa.py --deck-dir run with no cobrand and no logo findings, then (3) after
seeding each mutation, exactly one cobrand FAIL per mutated slide containing `expect`,
and none on the slide left untouched. Templates are picked from the ACTIVE pack by role
(first templateRoles.cover; the first content templates in name order whose logo is
dark, and the first whose logo is white), so the fixture follows a pack change instead
of rotting with it; closing = the pack's templateRoles.closing templates that carry a
logo, and no clean slide may carry a client mark taller than its pack logo (1.6.5: a
closing template with the 28 px content mark got the 48 px cover client size). Background: 2026-10-20 a 21-slide client deck carried a hand-pasted
23 KB base64 wordmark, truncated twice, and qa.py exempted the lockup from measurement.

slides.expect: must sit left of the pack logo
the deck's other content slides sit at
